layouts.name: Sturup Raceway
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Full road circuit retains the northern perimeter, western inner hairpin and southern return, excluding the rectangular southern detour. These branches match the historical catalogue configuration picture. The operator records a 2,087 m configuration from 2005; this coarser independent mapped draft measures 1,993.3 m against the catalogue 2,102 m. That distance difference is retained for historical alignment review, not corrected by stretching coordinates. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1993.3 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
